verdict.rationale: Relay documents role-based banking access for team members and financial advisors, and lets users define roles alongside card spend limits. That covers the core idea of assigning permissions to team members. There is no evidence of granular permission definitions or of scoping roles by location or department. A Trustpilot summary mentions minor permission issues, but that is not a concrete contradiction of the capability. Missing for 10: granular permission configuration detail, location-based scoping, department-based scoping, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can define granular user roles and permissions across team members, locations, and departments

citations.quote: Give team members and financial advisors secure, role-based banking access
set spend limits, define roles, and track every transaction in real time
